extension.summary: ABUKARIM Wizard - install, update and maintain ABUKARIM Kodi builds
معالج أبو كريم - تثبيت بيلدات أبو كريم لكودي وتحديثها وصيانتها
extension.description: ABUKARIM Wizard is the official installer and maintenance tool for ABUKARIM Kodi builds, with full English and Arabic support.[CR][CR][B]Builds[/B][CR]- Fresh install or update a build without wiping (No-Wipe), plus Patch GUI to refresh skin and GUI files in place.[CR]- Mandatory ABUKARIM TOOLS backup before any build install - no backup, no install.[CR]- Update notification when a new build version is released.[CR][CR][B]Accounts - Account Authorization[/B][CR]- Powered by Account Manager: Real-Debrid, Premiumize, AllDebrid, TorBox, Easy Debrid, OffCloud, Easynews, Trakt, Simkl and MDBList - authorize, view status, re-sync and revoke.[CR]- Keep your Trakt and debrid data across build installs.[CR][CR][B]Maintenance[/B][CR]- Cleaning tools: cache, packages, thumbnails, crash logs, databases, Fresh Start and scheduled auto-clean.[CR]- Addon tools: remove, enable/disable, force-refresh repos, force-update addons, whitelist.[CR]- Logging, speed test, network and system info, backup/restore and advanced settings presets by RAM size.[CR][CR][B]Arabic ready[/B][CR]Installs an Arabic-capable fallback font so menus and dialogs display correctly in any skin.[CR][CR]Based on Simple Wizard by Slam, Sarge, Funsterbe and BYB. Requires ABUKARIM TOOLS (installed automatically). Support: buymeacoffee.com/taiseer999

معالج أبو كريم هو أداة التثبيت والصيانة الرسمية لبيلدات أبو كريم لكودي، ويدعم اللغتين العربية والإنجليزية دعمًا كاملًا.[CR][CR][B]البيلدات[/B][CR]- تثبيت جديد للبيلد أو تحديثه دون مسح البيانات، مع خيار ترقيع الواجهة لتحديث ملفات الواجهة والسمة في مكانها.[CR]- نسخة احتياطية إلزامية عبر أدوات أبو كريم قبل أي تثبيت؛ فلا تثبيت بلا نسخة احتياطية.[CR]- تنبيه عند صدور إصدار جديد من البيلد.[CR][CR][B]الحسابات - مصادقة الحسابات[/B][CR]- بالاعتماد على مدير الحسابات: Real-Debrid وPremiumize وAllDebrid وTorBox وEasy Debrid وOffCloud وEasynews وTrakt وSimkl وMDBList؛ مصادقة الحسابات وعرض حالتها وإعادة مزامنتها وإلغاؤها.[CR]- الاحتفاظ ببيانات Trakt وخدمات الديبريد عند تثبيت البيلد.[CR][CR][B]الصيانة[/B][CR]- أدوات التنظيف: ذاكرة التخزين المؤقت والحزم والصور المصغرة وسجلات الأعطال وقواعد البيانات، والبدء من جديد، والتنظيف التلقائي المجدول.[CR]- أدوات الإضافات: الحذف والتفعيل والتعطيل، وتحديث المستودعات والإضافات قسرًا، والقائمة البيضاء.[CR]- السجلات، واختبار السرعة، ومعلومات الشبكة والنظام، والنسخ الاحتياطي والاستعادة، وإعدادات متقدمة جاهزة بحسب حجم الذاكرة.[CR][CR][B]جاهز للعربية[/B][CR]يثبّت خطًا احتياطيًا يدعم العربية لتظهر القوائم والنوافذ بوضوح في أي سمة.[CR][CR]مبني على Simple Wizard من تطوير Slam وSarge وFunsterbe وBYB. يتطلب أدوات أبو كريم (تُثبَّت تلقائيًا). الدعم: buymeacoffee.com/taiseer999
extension.disclaimer: لا تحتوي هذه الإضافة على أي محتوى
extension.news: v3.9.39: New addon summary and description in English and Arabic. v3.9.38: ABUKARIM TOOLS (plugin.program.abukarimtools 3.2.47 or newer) is now a required dependency - Kodi installs it automatically with the wizard. v3.9.37: Debrid & Trakt menu renamed to "Accounts - Account Authorization" (الحسابات - مصادقة الحسابات) with a new Accounts icon. v3.9.34: Simkl added to the Debrid & Trakt section (via Account Manager 1.2.0.2). Debrid services shown with their original brand logos and colours. Debrid section rebuilt on Account Manager (script.module.acctmgr) - Real-Debrid, Premiumize, AllDebrid, TorBox, Easy Debrid, OffCloud, Easynews, Trakt and MDBList with live status, authorize, account info, re-sync, view, revoke, revoke all and AM settings; Install Account Manager if missing; AM data kept with Save Trakt & Debrid Data; all menu icons resized to match icon.png. v3.9.33: Arabic strings rewritten in Modern Standard Arabic (Fusha). v3.9.32: Installing a build now forces an ABUKARIM TOOLS backup first - no backup, no install (retry or cancel). v3.9.30: Icons and fanart recolored from blue to mint green. v3.9.29: New main-menu entry "Support ABUKARIM - Buy Me a Coffee" - opens a QR code to buymeacoffee.com/taiseer999. v3.9.28: All icons on one solid dark background (#0D1116). v3.9.27: Smaller fanart logo; Update/No Wipe items use the normal fanart (their icon no longer fills the background). v3.9.26: New fanart to match the icon - wand ring with ABUKARIM WIZARD. v3.9.25: Simplified main icon - magic wand in a cyan ring with ABUKARIM. v3.9.24: Build Menu icon shows a ready build (package + check, READY BUILD). v3.9.23: New icons for Debrid, Update/No Wipe, Build Menu (themes), Addon Updates (auto) and the Update Available alert; fanart logo in the icon colours. v3.9.22: Every menu entry has its own icon (ABUKARIM line-icon set); ON/OFF rows show the on/off switch. v3.9.20: Ported the OpenWizard Maintenance feature. Maintenance is now split into Cleaning Tools (Total Clean Up / Clear Cache / Packages / Thumbnails / Archive_Cache with live sizes, Clear Old Thumbnails, Crash Logs, Purge Databases, Fresh Start, Auto Clean on startup with frequency), Addon Tools (Remove Addons, Remove Addon Data, Enable/Disable Addons, Force Refresh Repos, Force Update Addons, Whitelist), Logging Tools (Debug toggle, View Log, View Errors / Last Error), Misc (Network Info, Speed Test, Unknown Sources, Addon Updates mode, Reload Skin/Profile, Force Close), Backup/Restore (+ Clean Up Backup Folder) and System Tweaks (Advanced Settings, Scan Sources, Scan Repos, Convert Paths to special://, System Information). Whitelist, wizard and active skin are always protected. English + Arabic strings. v3.9.19: Merged all upstream Simple Wizard 3.0.9 updates while preserving every ABUKARIM fork feature (Arabic fallback font, Patch GUI, No-Wipe Option 2, custom artwork/background). Upstream additions now included: adaptive video cache read factor (Omega/Piers), auto-close on build install/fresh start instead of confirm dialogs, startup package cleanup now an enum (Disabled / every startup / 10 / 20 packages), Build Menu build-count label, Kodi system stats on the main menu (toggle in settings), update notification that pops once per new build version, whitelist name formatting cleanup, plus assorted upstream fixes (Fresh Start / Skip Swap) and code cleanup. v3.9.1: Arabic no longer shows as empty boxes on a fresh install. The wizard Main Menu is a plugin directory listing whose font is set by the active skin, not the wizard; when that skin's font (or Kodi's default fallback arial.ttf) has no Arabic glyphs the labels render as tofu. The wizard now installs an Arabic-capable global fallback font into media/fonts/arial.ttf at startup (and when the menu is opened, so it works even before a restart) - every skin falls back to it, so the menu and the wizard's popups become readable. Self-sufficient: prefers the font shipped by ABUKARIM TOOLS when present, else uses the copy now shipped inside the wizard. Takes effect on the next Kodi start; only rewritten when it actually differs. v3.9: Fixed shortcuts/widgets not refreshing on Arctic Fuse 3 - traced to AF3's own Home.xml onload (Action_BuildShortcuts_OnLoad), which already calls script.skinvariables to rebuild on every skin load, but only actually rebuilds if the Shortcuts.RebuildDateTime skin string has changed since it last checked (same mechanism as exiting AF3's shortcuts editor). Patch GUI now bumps that skin string to a fresh timestamp before ReloadSkin(), so the existing rebuild path fires correctly. Harmless no-op on skins that don't use this string v3.8: Removed the generated-includes cache-clear entirely. Inspection of Arctic Fuse 3's actual skin source showed script-skinvariables-includes.xml / script-skinviewtypes-includes.xml ship as real, static skin content (viewtype rules, percent-played variables) already correct at install - not a stale cache - so deleting them was destroying working skin files, not refreshing anything. Patch GUI now only extracts the patch zip and calls ReloadSkin(); any regeneration need is a packaging concern for the GUI patch zip itself, not something the wizard should force v3.7: Reverted the v3.6 script.skinvariables/skinviewtypes cache-delete - that addon only rebuilds when its own source template hash changes, not because its output file is missing, so deleting it was actively breaking Arctic Fuse 3 (missing includes/parse errors) until manually fixed via the shortcuts editor. Only the script.skinshortcuts cache-clear (confirmed safe) remains v3.6: Patch GUI's generated-includes cache clear now also covers script.skinvariables (script-skinvariables-includes.xml, script-skinviewtypes-includes.xml) in addition to script.skinshortcuts, since Arctic Fuse 3 uses skinvariables rather than skinshortcuts for its menu/widgets v3.5: Fixed Patch GUI calling Skin.Reset with no parameter (that builtin resets one named skin setting and requires it - was erroring and never actually reloading the skin); now correctly calls ReloadSkin(), which properly triggers shortcuts/widget refresh on all skins including Arctic Fuse 3. Arabic translation folder corrected to resource.language.ar_sa (matches Kodi's actual Arabic language addon id) and translations updated v3.4: Added Arabic translation (resource.language.ar); Patch GUI now also force-clears the active skin's cached script-skinshortcuts-includes.xml before Skin.Reset so shortcuts/widgets refresh automatically on skins (e.g. Arctic Fuse 3) that don't rebuild them on every skin load v3.3: Added "Patch GUI" menu item (Build Menu / Maintenance) - downloads the current build's GUI zip from Builds.txt and overwrites GUI/skin files in place without wiping the build, then runs Skin.Reset v3.2: Notify uses Arial font (Arabic support); notify pops automatically on build updates; startup save-items window removed; fixed Build Update menu item opening Advanced Settings
